observations: White microwave oven with a black control panel and door frame.
Brand 'AKAI' is clearly visible on the control panel in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3.
Control panel features two rotary knobs: one for power levels (M.Low, Low, Med, M.High, High, Combi.1, Combi.2, Combi.3) and one for timer (0-35 minutes) and defrost (0-0.4kg).
The interior contains a glass turntable and a metal wire rack.
The exterior casing shows some surface dirt and minor scuffs in photo 2.
The door glass appears clean in photos 0 and 1.

claims.evidence: The exterior shows some dirt and scuffs, but the interior appears clean.

claims.claim: Had bigger alternatives so didn't quite use this one much

risks.risk: The microwave may not heat or the magnetron may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the microwave heating a cup of water until it steams.

risks.risk: The turntable may be broken or the grill function may not work.
risks.proof: A video showing the turntable rotating and the grill light turning on.

risks.risk: The door seal or latch may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the door seal and latch area.

proof_requests: Video of the microwave heating a cup of water to demonstrate it works.
Video showing the turntable rotating and the grill function working.
Close-up photo of the door seal and latch.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an AKAI microwave oven. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
